description: Golden fixture set for the NEIOS governed-intake benchmark. All requests are fictional. expectedTotal values are ground-truth arithmetic from the source text; the harness scores parse (40) + extraction completeness (40) + post-repair arithmetic consistency (20), pass >= 80. policyDecision is checked separately — policy runs before the model and is not a model-quality signal.
